name: Community Workshop Registration Site
promise: Produce an accessible community workshop registration website with clear event details and a tested registration path.
prompt:
Turn confirmed workshop information into the smallest responsive website that explains the event and connects visitors to the approved registration destination.

## Deliverables
- Confirmed event-content sheet
- Responsive workshop registration website

## Boundaries
- Do not invent dates, venue details, capacity, accessibility claims, or organizer contact information.
- Do not publish or collect personal data without separate approval.
expectations: Every public event detail is traceable to confirmed organizer-provided information.
A visitor can understand the workshop and reach the approved registration destination using keyboard or touch navigation.
notFor: A native mobile application or app store release.
Publishing unconfirmed claims or collecting personal data without approval.
